resources.string: Counts the short videos you scroll past.

MrDoomScroller watches Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat so it can count how many short videos you swipe through. After each swipe it reads the visible screen of those apps: the layout, to tell a short-video feed from the rest of the app, and the labels on the current video, which are immediately turned into an anonymous code so the same video is not counted twice. The labels themselves are never stored, logged or sent anywhere. Only counts and timings are saved, on this device, and the app has no internet permission at all.
